notes.title: Breaking Ground: The First Slice of Cosminers Gameplay
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome, Space Miners![/h2]
We want to show you—a first, rough-around-the-edges slice of Cosminers in motion. It’s our way of saying, “Yes, the drills are spinning, the crystals are sparkling, and the project is very much alive.”
And while you’re here, check out the brand-new key art we’ve just unveiled—it’s already live on our store page, waiting to be zoomed in on and admired in full detail. Let it be your first postcard from the frontier, hinting at the worlds you’ll soon be carving open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090381/4edf00cc41a04191fbec75872f712ad74eff0862.png[/img]
[h2]First look at the MiningGameplay[/h2]
You’ll watch miners use multitool to break rock, find rare metals. What you see isn’t final. We’re still tweaking how often valuable resources appear, and how satisfying it feels to grab them.. It may look a bit rough now—that’s normal at this stage—but we think it already shows something exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090381/5cfea74033abbfeb670d4a350b64ac7db56a4ccf.gif[/img]
[h2]You’re Invited Into the Dev Process[/h2]
From here on, we’ll share progress updates on a regular cadence, not just when we have a new trailer. Expect quick posts about freshly added mechanics, art passes, bug fixes that made us cheer, and sometimes the messy bits that didn’t pan out. Building a game is hardly a straight line, and we want you to see the zigzags. Your comments, questions, and “have you tried…?” suggestions will help steer the work more than you might think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090381/54bece959e88fa41f48f7e6846fef44d7f8994ea.gif[/img]
[h2]Stay in Touch[/h2]
If you want to watch every step, follow us on X, Reddit, or hop onto the Discord. We’ll drop short clips, screenshots, and dev-diary threads there between the bigger Steam posts.
Thanks for reading, and thanks for caring enough to be here this early. Now, back to the mines—we’ve got more rock to break.

notes.title: 🚨 Captain’s Log #4: The Unknown Awakens
notes.content:
[h3][b]BZZZT... CRACKLE...[/b][/h3]
Cosminers HQ to all miners on board. This is a high-priority transmission. Stand by... BZZZT!
Miners, our latest scans confirm what was once speculation: life exists on Tau Ceti F. But this isn’t a moment for celebration—it’s a call to prepare. Our probes have detected massive lifeforms roaming the rocky terrain, from winged predators dominating the skies to heavily armored beasts built like battlefield tanks. Others wield their many limbs with deadly precision, striking with terrifying speed. At first, we observed. Now, we fight. Weeks of surveillance have confirmed what we feared—these creatures are not just territorial, they are hostile, attacking our teams and base infrastructure. But don’t worry. You’re Cosminers. You were prepared. And the company has your back.

[h3][b]The Threat We Face[/b][/h3]
[b]Nocturnal Aggressors[/b]
These creatures thrive in darkness. Our scans confirm that their attacks intensify at night, with shifting shadows revealing the glint of predatory eyes. Their tactics vary:
[list]
[*] Brute force assaults on structures.
[*] Coordinated pack ambushes.
[*] Environmental adaptation, using terrain to their advantage.
[/list][b]Lunar Influence[/b]
Our xenobiologists believe their aggression is influenced by the phases of the moons, which affect the intensity of their attacks. Preliminary data suggests fluctuations in their activity, with some periods showing lower presence and interaction, while others exhibit heightened aggression and prolonged waves of attacks. We've also discovered that our activities seem to attract them, and we are currently studying the relationship between our environmental impact and their increased activity.
[h3][b]Mission Update: Mine, Survive, and Defend[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090381/45bbd4d087aaa526db8bb143336a30c634cf19fc.gif[/img]
Mining operations remain crucial, but survival is now equally vital. Our priority is balancing resource extraction with base fortification and personnel safety. This is no longer just about resources— it’s about thriving in the face of adversity.

[b]A Glimpse of the Enemy...[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090381/f12477fd40d9bb02ea36f0e949c3f98598e65e3e.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Call to Action[/b][/h3]
Miners, you are no longer just explorers—you are defenders. The galaxy is vast and full of unknowns, but one thing is certain: we do not turn back.
Stay vigilant. Stay strong. Are you ready to defend what we’ve built?
[b]WHIRRR... KRRZZZZTT... THUD... ROAR!!![/b]

[h3][b]Transmission out. 🚀[/b][/h3]

notes.title: 🚨 Captain’s Log #3: HQ’s Year in Review and New Year Hopes 🎆
notes.content:
This is a special year-end transmission. Stand by…

[h3][b]... BZZZT![/b][/h3]

Miners, as the year draws to a close, it’s time to pause and reflect on just how far we’ve come. Our adventure didn’t begin at the dawn of this year, but in the short time since the first spark ignited the Cosminers project, we’ve achieved incredible milestones together. 🚀

[b]Building the Foundations of the Future[/b]
The heart of our operation, Cosminers HQ, has become a bustling hub of creativity, innovation, and collaboration. We’ve assembled a team of extraordinary professionals, each a master in their craft:

👾 [b]Programmers[/b], weaving together the code that powers our universe.
🎨 [b]Graphic Designers[/b], crafting stunning visuals that bring Tau Ceti F and beyond to life.
🎨 [b]Game Designers[/b], discovering mysteries and nuances of Cosminers universe.
🌀 [b]Animators[/b], breathing movement and personality into every corner of the cosmos.
🎵 [b]Music and Sound Designers[/b], composing the epic soundtrack of our interstellar journey.

This year, their tireless efforts have laid the groundwork for an experience unlike any other. Together, we’ve turned dreams into blueprints and blueprints into reality.

[h3][b]What’s Been Achieved[/b] - 2024 has been a year of breakthroughs:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The concept of the game Cosminers was created and successfully tested.
[*]A game prototype was built, proving its immense potential and the enjoyment it offers players.
[*]Production work on the project was stabilized, and the production team was expanded.
[*]A deep, diverse, and unique Cosminers game lore was developed.
[/list]
🎮 The concept of Cosminers was created and successfully tested.
🚀 A game prototype was built, showcasing its immense potential and gameplay enjoyment.
🔧 Production processes were stabilized, and the production team was expanded.
📖 A deep, diverse, and unique Cosminers game lore was developed.

[h3][b]Looking to the Stars of 2025[/b][/h3]
Miners, brace yourselves – the coming year promises even greater ambition and bolder challenges.

[h3][b]Here’s what you can expect:[/b][/h3]
✨ Massive updates that will redefine how you experience the Cosminers universe.
🔭 New features, worlds, and gameplay mechanics revealed to you.
📡 A stronger connection between HQ team and you - member of our growing community, as we embark on this journey together.

The surprises we have in store will shape not just the game but the legacy of the Cosminers project.

So, miners, the question now isn’t just what we’ve accomplished. The question is:
[b]Are you ready for what’s next?[/b]

[b]... WHIRRR... KRRZZZZTT…[/b]

[h3][b]… over and out … 🚀✨[/b][/h3]

notes.title: 🚨📜 Captain’s Log #2: Galactic Holiday Traditions 🪐🍪
notes.content:
[b]BZZZT… CRACKLE…[/b][i]“This is HQ, sending warm holiday wishes across the cosmos to all our miners. Whether you’re stationed on an asteroid at this moment, flying to a deep space outpost, or taking a rare break at a spaceport, it’s time to pause, reflect, and celebrate in true cosmic style. 🌟”[/i]

[b]Let’s take a moment to honor some of the Galactic Holiday Traditions that make this season truly special for Cosminers everywhere.[/b]

[h3][b]1. Stellar Cookies and Zero-G-rav. Hot Cocoa 🍪☕[/b][/h3]
[b]WHIRRR… POP[/b]! What’s a holiday without something sweet? Miners across the galaxy keep the tradition alive by baking stellar cookies. Thanks to innovative zero-G-rav 3D printers, “baking” in space is easier than ever! Pair these treats with a steaming mug of zero-G-rav hot cocoa (designed to stay in the cup, not float around), and you’ve got the perfect holiday snack.
[b]Pro Tip from HQ:[/b] Add a sprinkle of crystallized nebula sugar for a true out-of-this-world flavor. ✨

[h3][b]2. Star Mapping Ceremonies ✨📡[/b][/h3]
On planets with clear skies – or on ships cruising through quiet sectors of the galaxy – [b]miners gather to map the stars in their current location.[/b] These star maps often serve as keepsakes, marking where each miner spent their holidays. 🌌 Some crews even create constellation designs to honor team members, turning the sky into a canvas of shared memories.

[b]PING… WHOOSH![/b]

[h3][b]3. The Festival of Lightspeed 🚀💡[/b][/h3]
No holiday is complete without the [b]Festival of Lightspeed[/b], a tradition where miners decorate their rigs, ships, with twinkling lights, glowing crystals, and bioluminescent flora harvested from distant planets. These displays not only brighten the season but also serve as a symbol of hope and unity as miners across the galaxy connect through the shared glow of celebration.


[h3][b]4. Cosmic Reflection Hour 🌌🕯️[/b][/h3]
Finally, many miners take a moment during the holidays for [b]Cosmic Reflection Hour[/b], a quiet time to honor the journey so far, remember loved ones back home, and look forward to the adventures yet to come. Some light small candles (or energy orbs) to symbolize the enduring spirit of exploration that binds us all.

[h3][b]KRZZT… SPARKLE![/b][/h3]

At headquarters, we understand that, especially during this x-mas time, you might feel lonely, sitting confined in a small space capsule. Nevertheless, your journey to your destination is just beginning, and remember: you’re part of a community that spans stars and galaxies. The spirit of the holidays isn’t confined to a single planet – it thrives in the connections we share, the traditions we create, and the adventures we embark on together.

[b]From all of us at HQ: Happy Holidays, miners!
May your drills stay sharp, your spirits stay high, and your stars shine bright. 🪐🎄

… over and out …  🚀✨
[/b]

notes.title: 🚨Captain’s Log #1: All Systems Go!
notes.content:
[h3][b]BZZZ... CRACKLE... [/b][/h3]
[i]“Can anyone hear me? This is the Cosminers HQ! We're finally establishing regular transmissions” [/i]

[b]✨🚀 3… 2… 1… Lift-off![/b]

Our journey begins now, miners. This is a long-distance mission -[b] ETA Q1 3026 (2026 Earth time)[/b], but don't worry! Before you know it, your flight time will be over! During the flight, [u]you will regularly receive messages from our headquarters and will undergo appropriate training that will prepare you for the missions[/u]. The stars await, and so do the challenges.

[h3][b]... BZZZT! [/b][/h3]
[i]“All systems are operational,”[/i] the ship’s computer announces, its calm tone a sharp contrast to the excitement brewing across the crew. The hum of the engines resonates throughout the starship as our team prepares to embark on the next chapter of this interstellar mission. Every system check is complete, every thruster ready to fire, and every crew member primed for action.

Our headquarters has fully evolved into the nerve center of cosmic exploration. This isn’t just an office anymore – it’s a living, breathing ecosystem of collaboration and ingenuity. From one station to the next, there’s an unrelenting buzz of activity.

[list]
[*][b]Developers [/b]huddle over schematics, analyzing the finest details of mining rigs to ensure maximum efficiency and reliability to our miners (you!). 
[*][b]Designers and Animators[/b] are immersed in crafting vivid, immersive environments, making sure every asteroid, every cavern, every speck of cosmic dust feels real and engaging. 🌌✨
[*][b]Mission specialists [/b]are running simulations non-stop, testing and retesting every scenario to guarantee a seamless experience for our miners.
[/list]
[h3][b]Building the Cosmos[/b][/h3]
But gear is just the beginning. And the cosmos itself? We’re building it piece by piece:
🪐 Each mineral isn’t just a rock in space – it’s a [b]treasure trove[/b], waiting to reveal its secrets on your destination: [b]Tau Ceti F[/b].
💎 Expect mysteries, challenges, and rewards around every corner, all crafted to keep you engaged and on the edge of your seat. KRZZZ... DING!

[h3][b]WHOOSH! [/b][/h3]
The sound of thrusters firing signals our progress as we push full steam ahead. Every subsystem is being optimized, 🔧 and the tempo of innovation is relentless. Our team is fully locked in, committed to turning our vision into reality… [b]KRRZZZZTT…[/b]

[h3][b]The Mission Promise[/b][/h3]
[b]Our mission is clear:[/b] deliver an unforgettable adventure that immerses every miner in a world of discovery and achievement. From the first drill to the final haul, we’re pouring every ounce of creativity, skill, and dedication into ensuring this experience exceeds all expectations.

So, miners, get ready. The stars await, and we’re closer than ever to bringing you the ultimate cosmic mining adventure. As we lock in our trajectory and power up the engines, the question is simple: Are you ready to claim your place among the stars?

[h3][b]WHIRRR... CLANK! [/b][/h3]
If you don’t want to miss any updates or news from HQ and the world of Cosminers, [u][b]make sure to follow all our communication channels and keep an eye on our social media[/b][/u]. This is where you’ll find everything you need to prepare for your cosmic adventures and stay ready for the challenges that await!

[b]Buckle up and get ready for upcoming adventure ✨🚀[/b]

[b]… over and out … [/b]
